title: Middle Truncate
summary: Truncates long names and IDs in the middle at the real rendered width, so the end that tells files or wallets apart stays visible.
description: Text that truncates in the middle to the real rendered width so the distinguishing end (a file extension, the last characters of an ID) stays visible, while copy, title and screen readers always get the full value. Never splits emoji or accents.
catches: Lookalike items that differ only at the end
Emoji or accented characters split in half
limits: Measures width in the browser after layout, so server-rendered HTML shows the full value until hydration
Very narrow containers may still show only a few characters
a11y: The full value is in the accessibility tree; the truncated display is aria-hidden
Full value is also in the title when truncated
Copy puts the full value on the clipboard, not the ellipsis
stops: Picked the wrong file by prefix
